requirements: Execution requires a separate exact Instruction for this Work Unit and an independent native PRE_EXECUTION PASS. This candidate alone grants no execution authority.

Freshly observe repository identity, main SHA, STATE revision, all open PRs, all remote branches, all tags, branch protection, active Work Units, Instructions, Evidence, current immutable authority locators, and active review/bootstrap contexts. Record observation timestamp, source classification, and exact remote identities; stop on authority drift.

Read and obey the current .gpt-codex/schemas/evidence.schema.json and existing Evidence provenance conventions. The ledger is the sole durable output and includes kernel_version, schema_version, evidence_id, project_id, source, subject, state_revision, and result.

Classify every open PR as MERGE, CLOSE_SUPERSEDED, or KEEP_OPEN. Record number, base and base SHA, head and head SHA, draft/state, decision, decision reason, active review dependency, and review status. Fetch and inspect PR #15 current discussion, refs, draft/state, and review activity; CLOSE_SUPERSEDED / DO_NOT_MERGE is conditional on fresh proof. If PR #15 is no longer open and draft, or its identity, base/head refs, or relevant review state has drifted from the freshly observed execution baseline, record authority drift and stop; do not reopen, close, merge, or otherwise mutate the PR in this Work Unit.

Classify every remote branch as KEEP, DELETE_SAFE, or REVIEW_REQUIRED. Record name, head SHA, decision, ancestor_of_main, protected, open_pr_dependency, active_work_dependency, current_authority_reference_dependency, active_review_dependency, bootstrap_dependency, retained_remote_reachability, decision_reason, and review_status.

DELETE_SAFE requires per-branch proof: not main; not protected; no active work, open PR, active review, bootstrap continuity, or current Evidence/Instruction/Work Unit dependency; not the sole retained ref for durable authority; integrated/superseded or explicitly historical. Ancestor-of-main alone is insufficient. Unknown predicates require REVIEW_REQUIRED or KEEP.

For every proposed DELETE_SAFE branch, enumerate affected current durable-authority commits and prove each remains reachable from main, a retained tag, or another retained remote authority ref after deletion. If retained reachability cannot be proven, DELETE_SAFE is DENY.
Record every tag/ref identity and classification; retain all authority, release, and bootstrap tags. TAG_DELETE=FORBIDDEN.

Record counts for KEEP, DELETE_SAFE, REVIEW_REQUIRED, and all PR decisions. Set THIS_EVIDENCE_DOES_NOT_AUTHORIZE_PR_CLOSE=true, THIS_EVIDENCE_DOES_NOT_AUTHORIZE_BRANCH_DELETE=true, and THIS_EVIDENCE_DOES_NOT_AUTHORIZE_TAG_MUTATION=true, or schema-compatible equivalents.

Submit the exact ledger candidate to independent POST_EXECUTION review. Later metadata action requires GPT adjudication, user acceptance if required, ledger integration, immutable commit:path+blob locator, separate USER_LOCAL authority, and fresh per-ref revalidation.

Do not close or merge PRs; create, delete, or force-update branches; create or delete tags; modify main, STATE, CONTROL, consumer projection, source, documentation, VERSION, or release artifacts; implement Directory Creation Contract or Foundation; or release 2.8.0.
CODEX_IMPLEMENTER has no COMMIT or PUSH authority. This Work Unit authorizes no external GitHub metadata mutation.
